scope: Bounded alignment of quiesced live source rooms and integration with the existing atomic dungeon checkpoint/claim transfer. Public manual entry is not connected.

tests.goldenScenarios: Five existing complete state/RNG/reward fixtures unchanged; verified by full simulation suite

verified: Freeze all sources before choosing the common wall boundary; other rooms keep advancing
Advance with the ordinary kernel in ten-tick slices; bounded 256-slice coordinator and existing lease checks
Drain twelve same-time accepted commands without skipping or treating pending-input progress as an offline stall
Reject backward/future boundaries and preserve offline limits
Group source failure releases the preparation barrier; successful sealed source resumes through fenced abort
Two real-time human rooms plus three active NPCs transfer all twenty-two persistent identity claims
Committed target recovers via character routing and a fresh Worker admission; old sources cannot reacquire or unseal
Both humans retain private presentation access; foreign participant access is denied
Target participation records count once; transfer itself preserves item and wallet rows

initialFailures.cause: Fixture used separately anchored historical benchmark clocks instead of the shared UTC domain used by production character rooms
initialFailures.resolution: Use production-like presence and UTC wall clocks; retain future-advancement rejection

initialFailures.cause: Expected error regex did not match the actual access-denied error
initialFailures.resolution: Assert Presentation access denied; unauthorized access was correctly rejected

limitations: Live integration uses MemoryStore; existing PGlite atomic transfer tests passed in the full suite
No production PostgreSQL multi-connection fault or capacity measurement in this turn
Group authorization, readiness, public entry/routing and member departure are not wired
Only idle, out-of-combat personal sources with the required prepared roster are composable
No new browser, full shared encounter, boss kill or loot distribution acceptance
